suppress.notes: CVE-2026-54285 is opentelemetry-js (the @opentelemetry/core baggage propagator, target node.js). It does not apply to the Java artifacts (api, sdk, common), whose baggage code is a different codebase, or to opentelemetry-proto, which holds generated message classes only.
CVE-2026-39882 is the OpenTelemetry-Go OTLP HTTP exporter (target go). opentelemetry-proto is generated message classes only, with no HTTP exporter.
CVE-2026-41178 is OpenTelemetry-Go baggage Parse (target go). opentelemetry-proto is generated message classes only, with no baggage parsing.
CVE-2026-40894 is in the OpenTelemetry .NET NuGet packages (target .net). It does not apply to a Java jar of generated message classes.
CVE-2026-44967 is the OpenTelemetry-cpp OTLP HTTP exporter (target c++). opentelemetry-proto is generated message classes only, with no HTTP exporter.
